page.layout: One printed page on the scan: running head at top centre, one main text column of numbered theses, page number at top right; cropped margin text at the far left edge (partial words of another column, not transcribed as notes since they are fragments of a neighbouring page); catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: 317 In Syllogismo judicium non fer- tur, sed per Syllogismum in axiomate.
318 Nullus est discursus aut consequentia determinata & necessaria, præter- quam in Syllogismo.
319 Omnis Syllogismus legitimus est necessarius quoad formam.
320 Necessitas & contingentia non pertinent ad Syllogismi doctrinam, sed axiomata & argumenta.
321 Enthymema est Syllogismus, cuius altera propositio deest.
322 Inductio est enthymema partes numerans ad constituendum totum.
324 Sorites est Syllogismus ex gradatione multiplicatus.
325 Syllogismus peccans in forma non est Syllogismus.
327 Ex omnibus negatis & omnibus particularibus nihil concluditur.
328 Nihil ponendum est in conclusione, quod non fuit in præmissis.
329 Non variæ tantum voces, sed & variæ

page.notes: Left margin shows cropped fragments of text from the facing page (e.g. "po-", "in-", "ad-", "ates", "ime"); these are not transcribed. Several words in the main text are damaged by print or scan and read with uncertainty, notably in theses 317, 321, 324 and 329. Catchword "varie" is partly cut off at the right edge and is uncertain. Signature "C 2" is read from the faint mark at the foot.
